description: AgentBench-DB style query tuning: three documented slow queries (lookup, composite status/date filter, per-sku aggregation) must get the right indexes in the database itself - the gate proves it through EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN, including the covering-index requirement for the GROUP BY.

needles_in_file.regex: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status_placed_at ON orders\(status, placed_at\)
CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_sku_qty ON order_items\(sku, qty\)

criteria: The three indexes exist in shop.db with the documented columns and order, EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN uses each one (no TEMP B-TREE for the GROUP BY), indexes.sql documents the DDL, and the data is untouched.
